verdict.rationale: Foreloop gives developers an in-product feedback entry point: a single script tag or the npm package @foreloop/feedback, with a browser-safe widget key. Users press it and submit feedback without leaving the page, and submissions route to a project or the org Feedback list. The story asks for a link that sends users to a feedback portal, and the evidence describes an embedded widget, not a hosted portal URL to link to. Missing for 10: evidence of a standalone, linkable feedback portal page, any documentation for generating or sharing a portal link, independent or hands-on corroboration.
